meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 GitHub 的 issue 积压按根因聚类成少量 plan-master issue,用标准评论把子 issue 重定向并关闭,并把每个集群打包成一个架构修复 PR 一次性关闭全部子 issue。最终形态是未关闭 issue 数与未关闭 plan 数 1:1。
howto.when: 当仓库累积了 20 个以上同源缺陷的 issue,或你要求 triage、consolidate、cluster、dedupe 等整理动作,或要从 open issue 生成 plan 系列/路线图时触发。

say.text: 帮我 triage 这个新 bug,看它属于哪个已有 plan
say.note: 命中就往 master 追加 Round N 评论并关闭它

howto.what_en: Claude clusters a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a few plan-master issues, closes each child with a standard redirect comment, and ships one fix PR per cluster closing all children. End state: open issues equal open plans.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a tracker has dozens of reports sharing underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, or when building a plan series from open issues.

say_en.text: Cluster all open issues by root cause, open plan-masters and close the children.
say_en.note: It reads every body and comment thread first.

say_en.text: Triage this new bug and tell me which existing plan it belongs to.
say_en.note: On a match it adds a Round N comment and closes it.

say_en.text: Open a PR for the plan-02 cluster that closes every child with Closes #N.
say_en.note: The same PR also adds the plan's test matrix.
